entries.title: Psalms 10:1
segments: Why standest thou afar off, O Jehovah? Why hidest thou thyself in times of trouble?

entries.title: Psalms 10:2
segments: In the pride of the wicked the poor is hotly pursued; Let them be taken in the devices that they have conceived.

entries.title: Psalms 10:3
segments: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, And the covetous renounceth, [yea], contemneth Jehovah.

entries.title: Psalms 10:4
segments: The wicked, in the pride of his countenance, [saith], He will not require [it]. All his thoughts are, There is no God.

entries.title: Psalms 10:5
segments: His ways are firm at all times; Thy judgments are far above out of his sight: As for all his adversaries, he puffeth at them.

entries.title: Psalms 10:6
segments: He saith in his heart, I shall not be moved; To all generations I shall not be in adversity.

entries.title: Psalms 10:7
segments: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and oppression: Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 10:8
segments: He sitteth in the lurking-places of the villages; In the secret places doth he murder the innocent; His eyes are privily set against the helpless.

entries.title: Psalms 10:9
segments: He lurketh in secret as a lion in his covert; He lieth in wait to catch the poor: He doth catch the poor, when he draweth him in his net.

entries.title: Psalms 10:10
segments: He croucheth, he boweth down, And the helpless fall by his strong ones.

entries.title: Psalms 10:11
segments: He saith in his heart, God hath forgotten; He hideth his face; he will never see it.

entries.title: Psalms 10:12
segments: Arise, O Jehovah; O God, lift up thy hand: Forget not the poor.

entries.title: Psalms 10:13
segments: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God, And say in his heart, Thou wilt not require [it]?

entries.title: Psalms 10:14
segments: Thou hast seen [it]; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite it with thy hand: The helpless committeth [himself] unto thee; Thou hast been the helper of the fatherless.

entries.title: Psalms 10:15
segments: Break thou the arm of the wicked; And as for the evil man, seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

entries.title: Psalms 10:16
segments: Jehovah is King for ever and ever: The nations are perished out of his land.

entries.title: Psalms 10:17
segments: Jehovah, thou hast heard the desire of the meek: Thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear;

entries.title: Psalms 10:18
segments: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, That man who is of the earth may be terrible no more.
